scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run demo:build
scripts.bun:compile: mkdir -p dist && bun build scripts/play.mjs --compile --outfile dist/swarm-home-bun
scripts.prove:playable: bun run test:playable && bun run receipt:playable
scripts.great-bun:prove: bun run check && bun run prove:playable
scripts.evaluate:quick: bun run evaluate:boundary && bun run evaluate:lifecycle
scripts.evaluate:full: bun run check && bun run evaluate:playable
scripts.demo:build: rm -rf site-dist && mkdir -p site-dist && bun build site/main.ts --outdir site-dist --target browser && cp site/index.html site-dist/index.html
